name: Spicy Sichuan-Style "Dan Dan" Zucchini Noodles with Pork & Peanuts
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Trim zucchini; use a julienne (or regular) peeler to make noodles. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and roast, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onion, garlic, pork, salt, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and additional garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the bowl with the ginger and garlic. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Add tahini, water, soy sauce, vinegar, chili-garlic sauce, and additional oil to the bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
When the pork is done, add cooked zucchini noodles and sauce to the skillet; stir to combine. Cook, stirring frequently, until sauce is warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pork zucchini noodles between plates or bowls; top with reserved cilantro and peanuts. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
